Rogan gives his own take on David Grusch's UFO claims in a segment of the Joe Rogan Experience. Grusch, an intelligence officer, testified that the U.S. holds crashed craft and the remains of their pilots. Rogan, who has heard every kind of UFO story, sorts what he buys from what he doubts.

He weighs Grusch's record and calm manner against the lack of public proof. The talk also covers how the hearings changed what can be said on the record. The segment is a useful gauge of the disclosure moment, taken by the host who has done more than anyone to keep the subject in public view.
